details:
Here is a concise summary of your ASTROVITAL project:

* Project Name: ASTROVITAL (Multi-Planetary Mission-Adaptive Crew Health & Telemetry System)

* Challenge: 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge — "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions"

* Core Concept: An offline-first, environment-adaptive astronaut health intelligence platform that dynamically adjusts biometric priorities, environmental limits, and AI risk predictions across ISS, Moon, Mars, and Deep Space missions.

* Key Features:

* Biometric Face-Scan Login: Local webcam facial recognition (face-api) with live astronaut enrollment and instant demo fallback.

* Crew Profile & Primary Telemetry Strip: Displays the astronaut's portrait, rank/ID, last body checkup date, and live Body Temperature, Heart Rate, Blood Pressure, and Cabin Atmospheric Pressure.

* Live Space Equipment Simulator: Simulates onboard NASA instruments (HMS Vitals, PCBA Blood Analyzer, OCT/Tonometer, ECLSS) and compares live readings in real time against pre-flight (L-30d) personal baselines.

* Multi-Planetary Adaptation & Explainable AI: Dynamically shifts priorities per destination (e.g., lunar dust <0.3 mg/m³, Mars Sol circadian drift, Deep Space radiation), displaying transparent alert causes, 7–30 day trajectories, and confidence/uncertainty bounds.

* Interactive Body Map & PVT Test: Clickable anatomical SVG with plain-English ("non-doctor") self-exam cue cards plus a working 30-second Psychomotor Vigilance reaction-time test.

* Tech Stack & UI: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, and client-side face-api styled in a SpaceX Dragon-inspired Precision Telemetry UI (high-contrast dark-mode Bento grid with 1px hairline borders and tabular monospace metrics).
